findings.title: Redis security advisory (AV26-423) - original advisory
findings.summary_md: On May 5, 2026, Redis published a security advisory covering five CVEs: CVE-2026-23479, CVE-2026-25243, CVE-2026-25588, CVE-2026-25589, and CVE-2026-23631. CVE-2026-25243 is an invalid memory access in the RESTORE command that can lead to remote code execution. The advisory affects Redis Software and Redis OSS/CE releases.

findings.title: Redis RESTORE Flaw CVE-2026-25243 exploited in the wild - honeypot telemetry
findings.summary_md: Defused honeypots observed active exploitation of CVE-2026-25243 on October 16-17, 2026. The report recommends upgrading to Redis 8.6.3 or blocking the RESTORE command. The vulnerability was disclosed in May 2026 but unpatched servers remain exposed to remote code execution.
